data.overview: The only brand-specific sources are Glowria's own websites, which present marketing claims about vegan, cruelty-free, prostaglandin-free, and dermatologist/ophthalmologist-tested lash and brow products. No independent testing, ratings, or legal records naming Glowria appear in the fetched sources, so these claims are self-reported and unverified. Note that multiple unrelated businesses use the "Glowria" name (a candle warmer lamp shop and a health/beauty reseller), which are distinct from the lash/brow cosmetics brand.

claims.claim: Glowria states its vegan lash and brow collection contains no animal-derived ingredients.
Glowria claims its products are cruelty-free certified and never tested on animals.
claims.quote: Cruelty-free certified — never tested on animals

claims.claim: Glowria claims its formulas are dermatologist-tested and ophthalmologist-approved and free from parabens, sulfates and prostaglandins.
claims.quote: Clean beauty — free from parabens, sulfates & prostaglandins ✦ Sustainably sourced botanical actives ✦ Dermatologist-tested & ophthalmologist-approved

claims.claim: Glowria claims to use sustainably sourced botanical actives as part of an ethical, sustainable beauty philosophy.
claims.quote: botanical science with an ethical, sustainable beauty philosophy
